name: Wakae
source: “The youngest and also the quietest of the three, Wakae is a true silent assassin. Unlike her peers, she gets the job done without making a fuss. She’s a girl of few words and is not very good at expressing her own feelings, however, you’ve made her want to try. Can you help coax her out of her shell?”
